i: i — O!, hail (the vocative interjection that opens each declaration)
pr: pr — comes forth, 'who comes forth' (participle of pri, to go/come out)
iwnw: iwnw — Heliopolis, the sun-cult city (Budge: Annu)
n: n — not; negates the verb ('I have not …')
·i: ·i — I, me (1st-person singular suffix pronoun; the seated-man sign)
isft: isft — wrong, falsehood, disorder — the opposite of maꜥat
ḥpt-sšt: ḥpt-sšt — 'Embracer of flame', the 2nd assessor god (Budge: Hept-shet)
ḫr-ꜥḥꜣ: ḫr-ꜥḥꜣ — Kher-aha, a district on the Nile near Heliopolis (Old Cairo)
fnṯw: fnṯw — 'the Nose', the 3rd assessor god (Budge: Fenti)
ḫmnw: ḫmnw — Hermopolis, city of the eight primeval gods (Budge: Khemennu)
qrt: qrt — Qernet, the place the 4th god comes forth from
nḥꜣ-ḥr: nḥꜣ-ḥr — 'Dangerous of face', the 5th assessor god (Budge: Neha-hra)
rꜣ-sṯꜣw: rꜣ-sṯꜣw — Rosetau, the Sokar necropolis realm near Giza
rwti: rwti — the 'Double Lion' (Shu and Tefnut), the 6th assessor god (Budge: Rereti)
mꜣꜣ-f: mꜣꜣ-f — 'Whose eyes are of fire', 7th assessor (Budge: Fenti-of-fire)
ḫt-nṯr: ḫt-nṯr — the property of the god
grg: grg — to speak falsehood, tell lies
nḥm: nḥm — to take away, carry off, snatch
ḥwt-kꜣ-ptḥ: ḥwt-kꜣ-ptḥ — Memphis ('Mansion of the ka of Ptah'; Budge: Het-ka-Ptah)
kn: kn — to be violent, do harm
imntt: imntt — the West, the realm of the dead
nk: nk — to copulate; (here) fornicate / commit adultery
srmi: srmi — to make (someone) weep (causative of rmi)
wš: wš — to lay waste, make desolate
mꜣꜥti: mꜣꜥti — Maati, the hall/city of the Two Truths
ṯnmiw: ṯnmiw — 'He who strides backward', 18th assessor (Budge: Tenemiu)
šm-r: šm-r — 'to set the mouth going' — to speak against, babble
mꜣꜣ-int-f: mꜣꜣ-int-f — 'Watcher of what is brought to him', the 22nd assessor god (Budge: Maa-antu-f)
wsṯn: wsṯn — to act/judge with undue haste
sꜣwti: sꜣwti — Sais (a writing of the town; cf. sꜣw; Budge: Sauti)
sqꜣ: sqꜣ — to make high/loud (causative of qꜣi)
wḏ-rḫyt: wḏ-rḫyt — 'Commander of mankind', the 37th assessor god (Budge: Uatch-rekhit)
pꜣwt-nṯrw: pꜣwt-nṯrw — the cake-offerings of the gods
ꜥqw-nḫn: ꜥqw-nḫn — the food of a child
nṯr-niwt-f: nṯr-niwt-f — the god of his town
tꜣ-rd: tꜣ-rd — 'Fiery of legs' (Budge: 'Blazing legs'), the 14th assessor god
ꜣḫḫ: ꜣḫḫ — 'the darkness' (Budge: Akhekh), the place the 14th god comes forth from
ꜥm-snf: ꜥm-snf — 'Eater of blood', the 15th assessor god (Budge: Am-snef)
nmmt: nmmt — 'the block, the place of slaughter/execution'
ḥr-wr: ḥr-wr — 'Chief of the mighty' (Budge: Her-uru), the 23rd assessor god
ꜣmmt: ꜣmmt — Amemt, the place the 23rd god comes forth from
wtn: wtn — Uten, the place the 31st god comes forth from
nb-ꜥbwi: nb-ꜥbwi — 'Lord of two horns', the 32nd assessor god (Budge: Neb-abui)
ꜥš-ḫrw: ꜥš-ḫrw — 'loud of voice'; to multiply one's words, talk overmuch
sꜣq: sꜣq — robbery, theft (Budge reads the damaged sin here with a query)
ꜥm-šwt: ꜥm-šwt — 'Eater of shades', the 4th assessor god; glyphs write šwt 'shadow' (Budge romanizes Am-khaibitu)
ḥnwt: ḥnwt — deceit, wrongdoing (exact reading uncertain; the sin is acting deceitfully)
twtw-f: twtw-f — 'Doubly wicked', the 20th assessor (Budge: Tutu-f); written t-w-t-w-f
